trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum. Work through the story first, then clean up activities, collectibles and combat trophies. The roadmap below orders everything so nothing gets missed.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story, unmissable: finish the opening mission. It teaches the basics — fishing, driving, and switching between Lucia and Jason.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story, unmissable: play through Chapter 1 to its final mission. No side content is needed to reach the chapter's end.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story, unmissable: play through Chapter 2 to its final mission.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story, unmissable: play through Chapter 3 to its final mission.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story, unmissable: play through Chapter 4 to its final mission.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Story, unmissable: finish the final mission. After the credits, free roam stays open, so cleanup can continue.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story mission, unmissable: follow the markers through Breakfast Run. It unlocks in the natural course of the story.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story mission, unmissable: play through The Cartel Heist when it appears in the story.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story mission, unmissable: play through Child's Play when it appears in the story.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story mission, unmissable: play through Headliners when it appears in the story.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story mission, unmissable: play through VCIA Takedown when it appears in the story.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story mission, unmissable: play through Operation Savage Glory when it appears in the story.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The long one: story plus all activities, collectibles, stunts and side content. Everything that counts toward 100% is tracked in this checklist — the last few percent are usually stunts and collectibles, so save those for the end.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Stunts build up across jumps, near-misses and air time, and the counter is cumulative across the whole game. Farm the airport runway and the big highway jumps once the story opens them up.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sample all 9 activity types once — races, fishing, the shooting range, arcade games, drone races, bowling and the rest. One run of each is enough; you do not need to win them.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: 42 challenges across the shooting ranges. Gold needs accuracy and speed: learn the timing on the pistol sets first, then work through the rifle and shotgun sets.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: 14 drone-race locations. Learn each course with one slow run, then race it clean — cutting corners loses more time than it saves.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Any 20 distinct races count — street, off-road, boat and air. Replay the shortest ones if one race type gives you trouble.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: A story-linked fishing duel with Cal. Use the heavier tackle and keep the tension in the green; land the big catch first and Cal folds.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Play any arcade cabinet to completion. The shortest game in the Vice City arcade is the quickest route — one full playthrough counts.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's mission strand: his last job unlocks after the earlier ones. Check the map for his marker between story chapters.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's mission strand: his last job unlocks after the earlier ones. Check the map for his marker between story chapters.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's mission strand: his last job unlocks after the earlier ones. Check the map for his marker between story chapters.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Eight stranger strands across Leonida. Strangers appear as question marks on the map — clear each strand to its end. Some only appear after certain story chapters, so sweep the map again late in the game.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's mission strand: his last job unlocks after the earlier ones. Check the map for his marker between story chapters.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's mission strand: his last job unlocks after the earlier ones. Check the map for his marker between story chapters.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. Some spots sit in areas that change as the story advances, so clear them as you explore each region instead of leaving them for post-game cleanup.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret's hunting strand: track the unique animal he marks and take the shot cleanly. The trail and the kill both count.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Cards are hidden across Leonida — shops, interiors and out-of-the-way spots. Three full sets is the trophy; work set by set and the count climbs steadily.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: The WAiNK photo spots — 100 of them. The in-game app marks nearby spots, so sweep region by region and the count climbs fast.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Challenges stack up across combat, driving, flying and exploration. Just play broadly and check the challenges menu; the last ones are usually the grindy driving and flying sets.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, reach a 4-star wanted level, then break line of sight and stay out of the search cones until the heat dies. Tunnels and the swamps break pursuit fastest.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Three shops in a row, same wanted level, partner in tow. Pick three close shops, move fast, and do not let the cops reset the streak.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Drive everything you see — the counter ticks for each new model you discover. Car meets and varied traffic do most of the work.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Trigger Combat Focus in a busy firefight and chain five takedowns before it ends. Gang hideouts are the reliable spot.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: At the airport, grab a plane and leave without a flight plan — the runway dash is the trigger, not the destination.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Rhinos are the tanks. Provoke one and survive the response — the trophy is about the encounter, not destroying it. Keep distance and use cover.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Go in quiet: no alarms, no witnesses. Night, a careful approach, and out before the camera cycle turns.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Five vault jobs, each ending in a clean getaway. Plan the exit before the entry — the escape is what the trophy counts.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Hit a moving armored truck, crack it, and lose the heat. Trucks run set routes — learn one route, then strike.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: All 52 areas of Leonida. Drive every road and the fog lifts; the last areas are usually the islands and the swamp corners.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Nine gangs, one illegal operation each. Each gang's turf marks its operations — clear one per gang and the set is done.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Order a cocktail at the Ocean Beach bar and enjoy the view — a quiet moment trophy, no combat needed.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Drive through a vehicle showroom's glass in style — the classic entrance, now a trophy. Any showroom works; pick the one with the clearest run-out.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play a full frame at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley — the follow-through is the point, not the score.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership moment that unlocks as the relationship scenes with your partner play out through the story.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: A running count of story choices, tracked up to 500. Just play the story and make choices — it accumulates across chapters.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Fail something, then succeed on the retry — the trophy is for the comeback, not the failure.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: A strange encounter somewhere in Leonida — the kind of thing you stumble into off the main path. Keep an eye out in the swamps and on the desert roads.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: A melee drive-by knockdown — drive past on foot traffic and swing. Empty streets at night keep the wanted level down.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Marked bills come from heists. Launder them through your contacts in chunks — the $250,000 total is cumulative across the game.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Shopping counts: clothes, weapons, car mods. The $100,000 total is cumulative across all shops.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Eight garages across Leonida. They appear on the market as you progress and earn — buy each one when it shows up.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Photograph and register ten vehicles in the Scooter Bros app — any ten distinct vehicles count.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

meta.hidden_note: Story and secret trophies are hidden on PlayStation until earned; the spoiler setting hides them here too.
meta.missable_note: Positive Mental Attitude is the one missable trophy: clear meditation spots as you explore, before the story moves on.
meta.sources_note: Trophy names, descriptions and grades follow the official 55-trophy list; guides are original.
